segments.speaker: me
segments.text: This is the postmortem for INC-2291, the search outage on Monday. Blameless format, focus on systems.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Timeline first. At 9:12 the index cluster started rejecting writes, and alerts fired at 9:15.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I picked up the page at 9:17. Initial guess was disk pressure, but disks were fine.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: At 9:40 we realized a config push had dropped the replica count to zero on the new nodes.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: So the config change itself went through review?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: It did, but the diff was generated, so the reviewer saw a three-thousand-line change and approved the summary.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's a process gap, not a person gap. Let's note it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Recovery took until 10:55 because we had to rebuild two shards from snapshots.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: During recovery I needed to call the search provider's management API directly from my laptop.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: For the record, the key I used was FAKE-7Q2M-ZK41-PL09, it's the org-admin key, and it still isn't rotated because I couldn't find who owns it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Wait, that's the one that's also in the old runbook wiki. Anyone with the wiki link can use it right now.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, action item, and let's move on. What went well?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Alerting was fast. Under three minutes from first error to page.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: And the status page update went out within ten minutes, which customers noticed.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: What didn't go well, besides the generated diff?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The runbook for shard recovery was out of date. We lost twenty minutes on a deprecated command.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Action items: add a guard that blocks replica count zero in prod, split generated diffs from human ones, and update the recovery runbook.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'll take the guard.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'll take the runbook.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thanks both. I'll publish the writeup tomorrow.
